title: Rewrite the real token, leave the hallucinated tail untouched
why_real: ASR models sometimes append content nobody said, like a trailing 'thanks for watching'; the system must still fix the real name earlier in the sentence and must not touch, clean up, or drop the invented span.

inputs.formatted: Ask Karthik for the invoice. Thanks for watching!

expected.memory_aware: Ask Karthick for the invoice. Thanks for watching!
expected.reason: ok on the real token only; the hallucinated tail carries no memory and passes through byte-identical
